text:
Maya R: Kicking off an internal bakeoff for stella-13b variants: FP8, AWQ-INT8, GPTQ-INT8. Need a rollout+gating plan that covers hosted, dedicated, and private. Requirements: quality delta (NLG) <= 0.8% vs baseline, p50 latency <= 120ms hosted, p95 <= 350ms. Also want explicit fallback rules. Who owns the plan?
Sanjay K: I can drive the gating heuristics. Proposing: golden-set + live shadowing on 0.1% live traffic, 24h sample, then progressive canary if no regressions. Define "regression" as >0.8% accuracy drop OR >1% increase in hallucination rate on eval hooks.
Ellery: sharing a config snippet I used before for progressive canary and auto-fallback — we should reuse:```yaml
rollout:
  steps:
    - name: shadow-0.1
      mode: shadow
      traffic: 0.001
      duration: 24h
    - name: canary-1
      mode: live
      traffic: 0.01
      duration: 6h
    - name: canary-5
      mode: live
      traffic: 0.05
      duration: 12h
    - name: ramp-20
      mode: live
      traffic: 0.2
      duration: 24h
gating:
  quality_threshold_pct: 0.8
  latency_slo_ms:
    p50: 120
    p95: 350
  abort_conditions:
    - metric: quality_regressions_pct
      window: 10000
      threshold: 1.0
    - metric: latency_p95_over_slo_pct
      window: 1h
      threshold: 50
fallback:
  immediate: float32-hosted
  fallback_variants: [fwq-fp16, awq-safe]
  notify: #oncall
```
Lia P: For Dedicated/private we need capacity-aware routing: can’t just ramp to 20% if reserved pool is saturated. Suggest a pre-check: if reserved_gpu_util > 70% skip ramp and remain at canary-5 until autoscale triggers. Also tie tenant-level SLOs — some enterprise customers should be excluded from early canaries unless they opt in.
Toni: Agree. Also add sample-weighting for live eval so we don’t overweight short-chat queries. Use stratified sampling: 50% high-latency prompts, 30% long-context, 20% random. That helps catch regressions that affect specific slices.
Maya R: Good. Need concrete abort rules we can automate. Sanjay, can you add numeric triggers? e.g., abort if >0.8% quality delta over 10k golden queries OR if p95 latency exceeds SLO by >40% for 15m.
Sanjay K: Yup. Proposed numeric rules: - Quality delta (BLEU/QA-F1/token-match combined) > 0.8% across 10k-window -> abort and rollback. - Hallucination rate increase > 1.0% across 5k-window -> abort. - Latency: p95 > 1.4x SLO for 15m -> pause ramp, 2x -> abort. - Error rate >0.5% absolute -> abort.
Ellery: Add a staged fallback ladder: 1) immediate traffic split to baseline float32-hosted, 2) if problem persists >30m, drain variant and promote AWQ-safe, 3) persistent regressions -> rollback global and block variant until manual review.
Ops Bot: deploy-bot scheduled shadow job: stella-13b-awq shadow-0.1 -> start 2359990600, ETA 24h. :robot_face:
Lia P: One open question: telemetry & observability for private deployments. We need a light-weight agent that ships golden-set results back to control plane; else gating can’t run. Ops team OK?
Toni: We'll use the offline uploader with signed envelope for air-gapped installs. Can run local eval every 6h and ship diffs. Add a privacy flag to redact prompt text but keep metrics.
Maya R: Action items: Sanjay to prepare gating policy + CI job for golden-set (by EOD). Ellery to add rollout YAML to infra repo and ensure autoscale hooks honor ramp checks. Lia to confirm private telemetry path. Toni to create stratified sample selector and eval harness. I’ll run initial smoke with AWQ and FP8 on hosted shadow.
Sanjay K: I'll also add an automated ticket if abort triggers fire: include sample ids, short diffs, and link to failing golden examples.
Ellery: small note — test memory footprints too; AWQ can spike GPU memory on long contexts. Add mem-usage alert: if GPU mem > 92% for >5m pause ramp.
Maya R: :thumbsup: OK team, let's keep this minimal and iter-ate. I'll post the smoke results in this thread.
Toni: Thanks — will help with sampling and eval dashboards.
Ops Bot: Incident-bot: no incidents currently. Canary-monitoring channel created: #canary-stella-13b.
